newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Dec industrial output up 8.9 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Dec industrial output up 8.9 pct on year.

text.p: South Korea's industrial output in December rose 8.9 percent year on year, up from a 7.1 percent rise a year earlier, provisional figures by the National Statistical Office showed on Thursday.
Note: figures in percent, year-on-year changes.
Industrial output and ex-factory shipment rose 8.4 percent and 8.1 percent respectively in 1996, compared with 11.9 percent and 12.6 percent rises in 1995, the figures showed.
The office said in a report that industrial output declined by 0.9 percent in December from the previous month, against a 0.3 percent month-to-month drop a year earlier.
The report said production of heavy-industrial and chemical goods rose 12.7 percent year-on-year in December while that of light-industrial items fell 4.9 percent.
The report said ex-factory shipment for exports grew 20.0 percent in December from a year earlier, compared with a 5.7 percent rise in delivery for the domestic market.
Inventories fell 0.5 percent month-to-month in December, a third consecutive monthly fall, against a 2.1 percent rise a year earlier.
